name: Psychocybin Caps
disable: DC 35 Nature check or DC 35 Survival check to cut back the mushrooms without triggering the spores
reset: If a creature within 10 feet of psychocybin caps becomes Stunned 3, the effect generates enough mental energy to allow the fungi to reset.

items.name: Spore Eruption
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves onto the catwalk, Flies within 10 feet of the mushrooms, or damages the mushrooms

---
Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within 10 feet of them are exposed to psychocybin spores.

items.name: Psychocybin Spores
items.text:
A creature that becomes Stunned 3 reacts by releasing anything they're carrying. If the creature is holding onto a ladder, they fall.

Saving Throw DC 36 Will save

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 1d12+12 mental damage (1 round)

Stage 2 2d12+12 mental damage and Stunned 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d12+12 mental damage and stunned 3 (1 round)

text: The mushrooms release spores that cause hallucinations, allowing the fungi to feed off the victim's psychic energy.
